title: Upper Density Theorem for a set locally finite in an open set (Simon Ch. 1, Remark 3.7(2))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let S ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set with H^n(S ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, where H^n = μHE[n]. Then for H^n-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P: if x ∈ U and x ∉ S, then H^n(S ∩ closedBall(x, ρ)) / ρ^n → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 (the quotient taken in [0, ∞], with ρ^n = ENNReal.ofReal(ρ)^n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U S : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet S → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (S ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∈ U → x ∉ S → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μHE[n] (S ∩ closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
